Marks the current task as complete and terminates the agent loop. Use ONLY after validating that the objective has been fully achieved by actually running the project, checking the outputs, and making sure the user's objective is completely satisfied by the results. 
Schema:
  reason (str, optional, default="Task completed."): A brief summary of what was accomplished and how it was verified.
Example: {"tool_name": "task_complete", "parameters": {"reason": "Built Docker image, ran tests, all 12 tests passed."}}
